messages.subject: Missing data at the observation level
parts:
Hi all,

I am a first time Distance user and am struggling with the data import stage.

My text file contains 125 unique censuses (rows) and only 29 sightings (yes, we have a lot of censuses with no sightings). When I import the .txt file, however, the 'observation' page only show 77 cells and 26 sightings. The rest of the data is gone. I have checked and double checked that the .txt file is accurate, and I just cannot figure out what I am doing wrong to lose all of those cells. 

My data is entered like this:

Stratum    Stratum Area    Transect Label    Transect Length     Observation      Cluster (1 for all)
K1;1.31;T3;900;14;1                
K2;.9;T2;900; 

Just to reiterate, the observations are not showing up *before* truncating the data to 10%. They are gone from the start.

I would really appreciate any help you could offer.

Kind regards,
Lauren Gilhooly
